newsitem.title: USA: US mortgage-backeds snooze, more napping expected.
newsitem.headline: US mortgage-backeds snooze, more napping expected.

text.p: U.S. mortgage-backed securities held largely unchanged on Monday as the market continued its holiday lull, traders said.
"The market's close to unchanged in mortgages and in Treasuries," reported one trader.
By late Monday, only lower-coupon paper had wandered slightly from Friday's close, with 30-year Ginnie Mae discounts, for instance, off 1/32.
"There's no activity either way," said one of several traders who cited neither buying nor selling.
In specific key coupons, Ginnie Mae 30-year 7.5 percent paper was unchanged at 100-20/32, yielding 114 basis points over the 10-year Treasury note.
Comparable Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac issues were unchanged as well, at 100-16/32 and 100-20/32, respectively.
The 10-year note was off 1/32 at 101-15/32 bid, yielding 6.30 percent.

Looking ahead to Tuesday's abbreviated trading session, "everyone's wondering how quiet it's going to be and how early they can leave," one trader said. PSA The Bond Market Trade Association recommended a 1400 EST/1900 GMT close on Tuesday.
